title: Surreal Dreamscape Collage
description: A composite surreal painting divided into distinct scenes. Top section shows a futuristic city with boats on reflective water at sunset under a dramatic blue fabric-like sky; two large iridescent green snakes coil in the upper right. Bottom left features a dark hooded silhouette with glowing orange drips against a red cosmic background. Center displays a classical still life with flowers, fruit and a glowing lantern. Bottom right shows a close-up of a blonde woman with closed eyes and golden tears streaming from her mouth, framed by a glowing blue arc.
prompt: Surreal composite painting featuring multiple distinct scenes: a futuristic sunset city with boats on reflective water and dramatic flowing blue fabric sky, two large iridescent green snakes coiled in the mist, a dark hooded silhouette with glowing orange drips against a red cosmic background, a classical floral still life with lantern and fruit, and a close-up of a pale blonde woman with closed eyes and golden tears flowing from her mouth, all blended together in a dreamlike composition with rich painterly textures.
